name: Type fast
description: A Monkeytype-style typing test: common words, your own word list or a passage, by word count or timed. Graded by WPM against a target.
author: Zibhelina

types.name: Type fast
types.description: A typing test in the style of Monkeytype: common words, your own word list or a passage, by word count or against the clock. The clock starts on the first key and the result is your WPM. Score = WPM ÷ target.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Optional line shown above the test (also the card's title in lists).

fields.name: text
fields.description: A passage to type exactly. Leave empty to draw random words instead.

fields.name: wordlist
fields.description: Words to draw from (vocabulary, keywords, names). Empty: the 200 most common English words.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Words in a word-count test, 5 to 200. Ignored for a passage or a timed test.

fields.name: seconds
fields.description: 0 for a word-count test, or 10 to 120 for a timed one.
